metadata.name: conformance flowSections__headerFooter
metadata.description: A flow Collection of two sections: the first declares a header, three cells and a footer, the second a header and two cells. Each header is a full-width row above its section's wrap and the footer a row below it, the 60-wide view at the row's start — not an item on the cells' line. A platform that draws no flow section header or footer renders this like its control.
